name: Akuyaku Reijou Oyako no Geboku ni Natta no de Haramase Onaho ni Shitsukete Hametsu End o Kaihi Suru
original_name: 悪役令嬢母娘の下僕になったので孕ませオナホに躾けて破滅ＥＮＤを回避する
source:
Thinking he had died in a traffic accident, instead the protagonist is transported to an
otome game world. He tried to persuade the villainous Elizabeth to change her ways,
but her obstinacy makes him give up, and he conquers her sexually instead. This new approach to avert disaster seems to work, but next he has to deal with the true mastermind: Elizabeth's mother, Mirza.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE259033.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公原以为自己死于交通事故，却意外穿越到了乙女游戏的世界。他试图劝说反派千金伊丽莎白改过自新，但她的固执令他放弃了劝说，转而以性爱征服了她。这种避免毁灭结局的新办法似乎奏效了，但接下来，他还得对付真正的幕后主使：伊丽莎白的母亲米尔扎。

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE259033.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
